# orevrkplus

> Official website and API documentation for orevrkplus.

## Documentation
- [orevrkplus API Documentation](https://orevrkplus.site/Docs): Implemented GET /api/time endpoint and JSON response.
- [orevrkplus create-ovk-app CLI](https://orevrkplus.site/cli): Verified version 1.0.1, Node.js 20+, quick start, build and export commands.
- [orevrkplus SDK](https://orevrkplus.site/sdk): @onenex/sdk example status; release and API contract not verified.
- [orevrkplus MCP server](https://orevrkplus.site/mcp): Availability status; no verified connection endpoint.

## Source
- [Website repository](https://github.com/z-ey3eiei/orevrkplus.site)
- [GitHub maintainer](https://github.com/z-ey3eiei)

Do not infer released SDK methods, CLI flags or MCP endpoints from marketing examples.
